name: Paimbnails
description: Thumbnails, capture, visual effects, audio, emotes, profiles, and custom backgrounds for Geometry Dash.

auto-update.name: Auto Update
auto-update.description: Download and apply updates automatically when the game closes.

mod-previews-enable.name: Mod Previews
mod-previews-enable.description: Show preview images for Geode mods whose repository has a 'previews' folder (preview-1.png ... preview-10.png).

level-search-enter.name: Quick Search Key
level-search-enter.description: Key to trigger search in the level browser.

realtime-search-preview.name: Realtime Search Preview
realtime-search-preview.description: Shows search results as you type.

smooth-scroll.name: Smooth Scroll
smooth-scroll.description: Smooth mouse wheel scrolling in menus and lists.

search-history-title.name: Search History
search-history-title.description: Save and re-run your recent level searches.

incognito-mode.name: Incognito Mode
incognito-mode.description: Hide the search history button and stop saving any searches.

discord-rpc-enabled.name: Enable Discord Rich Presence
discord-rpc-enabled.description: Show your activity on Discord. Configure details in Paimon Hub > Discord.

level-thumb-width.name: Thumbnail Size
level-thumb-width.description: Width of the thumbnail area in level cells.

compact-list-mode.name: Compact Mode
compact-list-mode.description: Shorter level cells to fit more on screen.

auto-preview-title.name: Auto Previews
auto-preview-title.description: Generate a thumbnail for levels that have none by rendering a small zone of the level.

auto-preview-enable.name: Auto Previews
auto-preview-enable.description: For levels with no thumbnail, automatically generate one. By default this happens for free when you play such a level (a clean frame is captured and reused as its thumbnail everywhere).

auto-preview-quality.name: Preview Quality
auto-preview-quality.description: Resolution of generated previews. Higher = sharper but a bit larger on disk.

auto-preview-badge.name: Show 'AUTO' Badge
auto-preview-badge.description: Mark auto-generated previews so they are not confused with real, community-made thumbnails.

auto-preview-browser-gen.name: Generate In Level List (Experimental)
auto-preview-browser-gen.description: EXPERIMENTAL, desktop only. Also generate previews directly from the level browser by rendering levels off-screen, without you having to play them. This is heavy (each level is fully loaded once) and is rate-limited to one at a time. Leave off if you notice instability.

auto-preview-max-objects.name: Max Level Size
auto-preview-max-objects.description: Skip browser generation for levels with more objects than this (avoids long freezes on huge levels).

auto-preview-max-per-session.name: Max Previews Per Session
auto-preview-max-per-session.description: Hard cap on how many browser previews are generated each time you open the game.

auto-preview-clear.name: Clear Generated Previews
auto-preview-clear.description: Delete every auto-generated preview from disk. Real thumbnails and your own captures are not affected.

levelinfo-background-style.name: Background Style
levelinfo-background-style.description: Visual style of the level info background.

dynamic-song.name: Dynamic Song
dynamic-song.description: Play the level song at a random position when viewing level info.

profile-redesign-enabled.name: Redesign Profile
profile-redesign-enabled.description: Reimagines the profile page with a modern layered-card layout: an identity header, framed action rails, a stats strip, and a refined activity frame. Designed to combine with profile backgrounds and all other Paimbnails profile features.

profile-music-enabled.name: Enable Profile Music
profile-music-enabled.description: Play custom music when viewing profiles.

menuMusicEnable.name: Enable Menu Music Player
menuMusicEnable.description: Vinyl button in main menu for library, playlists and downloads.

menu-music-cover-debug.name: Menu Music Cover Debug
menu-music-cover-debug.description: Log cover loading diagnostics to Geode console and saveDir/menu-music/cover-debug.log (works even when Debug Logs is off).

open-menu-music-folder.name: Open Menu Music Folder
open-menu-music-folder.description: Open the folder with cover-debug.log, library.json and saved song covers.

editorMusicEnable.name: Enable Editor Music
editorMusicEnable.description: Listen to your music library inside the level editor on a separate audio channel. Toggle the mini player with the Editor Music keybind.

editorMusicToggleKeybind.name: Toggle Editor Music
editorMusicToggleKeybind.description: Show/hide the editor music mini player (only works inside the level editor).

menuLoopConstantShuffle.name: Menu Loop Shuffle
menuLoopConstantShuffle.description: Change menu loops automatically after each song finishes.

menuLoopEnableNotification.name: Now Playing Notifications
menuLoopEnableNotification.description: Show a toast when the menu loop song changes.

menuLoopNotificationTime.name: Notification Duration
menuLoopNotificationTime.description: How long the Now Playing toast stays on screen (seconds).

menuLoopCustomPrefix.name: Notification Prefix
menuLoopCustomPrefix.description: Text shown before the song name in the toast. Use [Empty] to hide.

menuLoopSeekAmountMs.name: Seek Step (ms)
menuLoopSeekAmountMs.description: Milliseconds the skip forward/backward buttons move.

menuLoopShowPlaybackProgress.name: Show Playback Progress
menuLoopShowPlaybackProgress.description: Show the seek bar and skip buttons inside the Menu Music popup.

menuLoopEnableKeyboardShortcuts.name: Menu Music Hotkeys
menuLoopEnableKeyboardShortcuts.description: YouTube/VLC/Spotify-like hotkeys inside the Menu Music popup (0-9 to seek, Ctrl+S to shuffle, etc.).

menuLoopSaveSongOnGameClose.name: Remember Last Menu Loop
menuLoopSaveSongOnGameClose.description: Resume the last menu loop when you reopen the game.

menuLoopRandomizeOnLevelExit.name: Randomize on Level Exit
menuLoopRandomizeOnLevelExit.description: Pick a new menu loop when you quit back from a level.

menuLoopRestoreOnLevelExit.name: Restore Position on Level Exit
menuLoopRestoreOnLevelExit.description: Resume the previous menu loop from where it was when you return from a level.

menuLoopRandomizeOnEditorExit.name: Randomize on Editor Exit
menuLoopRandomizeOnEditorExit.description: Pick a new menu loop when you quit from the editor.

menuLoopRestoreOnEditorExit.name: Restore Position on Editor Exit
menuLoopRestoreOnEditorExit.description: Resume the previous menu loop from where it was when you return from the editor.

colorful-icons-enabled.name: Paimon Icons (Recolor)
colorful-icons-enabled.description: Recolor every icon (icon kit, shops, achievements, rewards) using your player colors. Detailed settings - color modes, lock styles, animations, presets - are inside the garage gear button.

global-icons-enabled.name: Global Icons
global-icons-enabled.description: Show other players' shared custom icons on their profile, and share yours from the profile settings gear. Requires the More Icons mod.

global-icon-server-url.name: Global Icon Server URL
global-icon-server-url.description: Base URL of your deployed Global Icon server (Vercel). Must match the server whose PAIMON_API_KEY equals the mod's API key.

custom-slider-enabled.name: Custom Slider Thumb
custom-slider-enabled.description: Replace slider thumbs with your player icon.

dynamic-popup-enabled.name: Dynamic Popups
dynamic-popup-enabled.description: Custom entry/exit animations for Paimbnails popups.

dynamic-exit-enabled.name: Dynamic Popup Exit
dynamic-exit-enabled.description: Apply dynamic transition effects when closing Paimbnails popups.

popup-blur-enabled.name: Popup Blur
popup-blur-enabled.description: Blur the background behind Paimbnails popups.

popup-ui-theme.name: Popup UI Theme
popup-ui-theme.description: Visual style of Paimbnails popups. 'gd' = original, 'glass' = blur + black borders, 'dark' = dark mode, 'carbon' = carbon fiber, 'aurora' = animated gradient border, 'minimal' = clean with soft shadow. Glass/Dark/Carbon/Aurora enable popup blur automatically.

custom-cursor-enable.name: Custom Cursor
custom-cursor-enable.description: Replace the OS cursor with a custom image.

enable-thumbnail-taking.name: Enable Capture Button
enable-thumbnail-taking.description: Show capture button in pause menu.

settings-panel-keybind.name: Open Settings Panel
settings-panel-keybind.description: Key to open/close the Paimon settings panel.

capture-keybind.name: Capture Thumbnail
capture-keybind.description: Key to capture a thumbnail during gameplay.

zoom-in-keybind.name: Zoom In
zoom-in-keybind.description: Zoom in while the game is paused.

zoom-out-keybind.name: Zoom Out
zoom-out-keybind.description: Zoom out while the game is paused.

zoom-reset-keybind.name: Reset Pause Zoom
zoom-reset-keybind.description: Reset zoom and show the pause menu.

zoom-toggle-menu-keybind.name: Toggle Pause Menu
zoom-toggle-menu-keybind.description: Hide or show the pause menu during pause zoom.

main-menu-layout-keybind.name: Layout Editor
main-menu-layout-keybind.description: Opens the button layout editor on the main menu and pause menu.

volume-scroll-title.name: Volume Scroll
volume-scroll-title.description: Modifier + scroll wheel to change volume in-game and in the editor.

volume-music-mod-game.name: Music Volume (Game)
volume-music-mod-game.description: Hold this key (or right-click / a configured mouse button) while scrolling to change the music volume during gameplay. Can be a single key (e.g. T), a modifier (Ctrl), or a combination (Ctrl+T).

volume-sfx-mod-game.name: SFX Volume (Game)
volume-sfx-mod-game.description: Hold this key while scrolling to change the SFX volume during gameplay.

volume-music-mod-editor.name: Music Volume (Editor)
volume-music-mod-editor.description: Hold this key while scrolling to change the music volume in the level editor.

volume-sfx-mod-editor.name: SFX Volume (Editor)
volume-sfx-mod-editor.description: Hold this key while scrolling to change the SFX volume in the level editor.

enable-disk-cache.name: Disk Cache
enable-disk-cache.description: Save thumbnails to disk to avoid re-downloading.

gd-robtop-cache-enabled.name: RobTop Response Cache
gd-robtop-cache-enabled.description: Cache Geometry Dash server responses (profiles, level searches, comments, etc.) on disk for 7 days to reduce rate limits. Live message/friend polling is never cached.

clear-cache-on-exit.name: Clear Cache on Exit
clear-cache-on-exit.description: Delete cached thumbnails when the game closes.

open-thumbnails-folder.name: Open Thumbnails Folder
open-thumbnails-folder.description: Open the folder where downloaded thumbnails are stored on disk.

texture-studio-enabled.name: Enable Texture Studio Button
texture-studio-enabled.description: Show the Texture Studio button in the main menu.

texture-studio-auto-apply.name: Auto-apply on Generate
texture-studio-auto-apply.description: Automatically copy generated packs to Texture Loader's packs folder.

comment-mentions-title.name: Comment Mentions
comment-mentions-title.description: Get notified when someone mentions you in level comments.

mentions-enabled.name: Enable Comment Mentions
mentions-enabled.description: Periodically check level comments and notify you when your name (or an alias) is mentioned. This makes requests to the Geometry Dash servers while you play.

mentions-aliases.name: Aliases
mentions-aliases.description: Comma separated names to watch for in comments. Defaults to your username on first launch.

mentions-enable-everyone.name: Notify on @everyone
mentions-enable-everyone.description: Also get notified when a comment uses the @everyone alias.

mentions-require-at.name: Require @ Sign
mentions-require-at.description: Only notify when the mention starts with a literal '@'.

mentions-custom-ids.name: Custom Level IDs
mentions-custom-ids.description: Comma separated level IDs whose comments will also be checked.

mentions-refresh-rate.name: Refresh Rate (s)
mentions-refresh-rate.description: How often (in seconds) the servers are checked. Low values may get you rate limited.

mentions-max-notifications.name: Max Notifications
mentions-max-notifications.description: If more than this many new mentions arrive at once, they are compressed into a single notification.

mentions-user-blacklist.name: User Blacklist
mentions-user-blacklist.description: Comma separated usernames you don't want notifications from.

mentions-word-blacklist.name: Hidden Words
mentions-word-blacklist.description: Comma separated words; comments containing any of them are ignored. Leave empty to disable filtering.

msgnotif-title.name: Message Notifications
msgnotif-title.description: Get notified when you receive a new message or friend request. Polls the Geometry Dash servers while logged in.

msgnotif-enabled.name: Enable Message Notifications
msgnotif-enabled.description: Periodically check for new messages and friend requests and show a notification.

msgnotif-check-interval.name: Check Interval (s)
msgnotif-check-interval.description: How often (in seconds) to check for new messages and friend requests. Low values may get you temporarily IP banned.

msgnotif-stop-friends.name: Stop Friend Request Notifications
msgnotif-stop-friends.description: Disable notifications for new friend requests.

msgnotif-disable-while-editing.name: Disable While Editing
msgnotif-disable-while-editing.description: Don't check while in the level editor.

v107-title.name: New Features (v1.0.7)
v107-title.description: Song search by name, My Levels filters, and menu physics.

song-search-enable.name: Search Song By Name
song-search-enable.description: Type a song name in the custom-song ID box and the first Newgrounds match is selected automatically. Numeric IDs still work as usual.

editor-filters-enable.name: My Levels Filters
editor-filters-enable.description: Adds a filter button to the My Levels tab to filter your created levels by length, verification status, and song ID.

menu-physics-enable.name: Menu Physics
menu-physics-enable.description: Makes the buttons on any menu screen drop, bounce, and become draggable. Can also be toggled in-game from the right-click menu (below Invert). Just for fun.

menu-physics-gravity.name: Physics: Gravity
menu-physics-gravity.description: Strength of gravity for Menu Physics. Negative pulls down, positive pulls up.

menu-physics-bounciness.name: Physics: Bounciness
menu-physics-bounciness.description: How much buttons bounce off the walls. 0 = no bounce, 1 = very bouncy.

menu-physics-friction.name: Physics: Friction
menu-physics-friction.description: Higher values make buttons lose speed faster when they slide along walls.

menu-physics-air-drag.name: Physics: Air Drag
menu-physics-air-drag.description: How much buttons slow down while flying through the air. 0 = no drag, 1 = very floaty.

menu-physics-angular-drag.name: Physics: Spin Drag
menu-physics-angular-drag.description: How fast buttons stop spinning. 0 = spin forever, 2 = stop quickly.

menu-physics-push-power.name: Physics: Push Power
menu-physics-push-power.description: Click empty space to push nearby buttons away. 0 = disabled, 2 = very strong.

menu-physics-mass-by-size.name: Physics: Mass By Size
menu-physics-mass-by-size.description: Bigger buttons are heavier and push smaller ones around more realistically.

menu-physics-remove-ceiling.name: Physics: Remove Ceiling
menu-physics-remove-ceiling.description: Let buttons fly out past the top of the screen instead of bouncing off it.

editor-colorpicker-title.name: Editor Color Picker
editor-colorpicker-title.description: Eyedropper tool inside the level editor.

editor-color-picker-enable.name: Editor Color Picker
editor-color-picker-enable.description: Adds a square eyedropper button to the editor's top-right button menu. It freezes the screen, shows an imagecolorpicker-style magnifier, and lets you click any pixel to pick its color. Copy it as HEX / RGB / GD format, or type a color channel ID to load the picked color into Geometry Dash's color editor.

editor-color-picker-keybind.name: Open Color Picker (Editor)
editor-color-picker-keybind.description: Opens the editor color picker eyedropper. Only works inside the level editor.

enable-debug-logs.name: Debug Logs
enable-debug-logs.description: Show detailed mod logs in Geode console.
